name: Meiofauna
description: Tiny invertebrates living between sediment grains - nematodes, harpacticoid copepods, foraminifera and kin. Functional group aggregating the meiobenthos community as a single source compartment; feeds on benthic diatoms and sediment bacteria. Nothing in the published network consumes it. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the annual mean in mgC/m2.
